from-binary-freeze.sql: COPY "ticket" ("id") FROM STDIN WITH (FORMAT binary, FREEZE true)

from-csv-forced.sql: COPY "ticket" ("id", "note", "label") FROM STDIN WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER match, QUOTE E'\'', ESCAPE E'\\', FORCE_NOT_NULL ("note"), FORCE_NULL *, ON_ERROR ignore, LOG_VERBOSITY silent)

from-text-options.sql: COPY "app"."account" ("id", "name", "note") FROM STDIN WITH (FORMAT text, DELIMITER '|', NULL 'NULL', DEFAULT '@default', HEADER true, ON_ERROR ignore, REJECT_LIMIT 10, ENCODING 'UTF8', LOG_VERBOSITY verbose) WHERE "id" > 3 AND "name" <> E'O\'Brien'

to-delete-returning.sql: COPY (DELETE FROM "app"."account" WHERE "id" > 3 RETURNING *) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT csv, FORCE_QUOTE *)

to-insert-returning.sql: COPY (INSERT INTO "ticket" ("note") VALUES ('x') RETURNING "id") TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT binary)

to-select-csv.sql: COPY (SELECT "id", "name" FROM "app"."account" WHERE "name" = E'O\'Brien') TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT csv, DELIMITER ';', NULL '-', HEADER true, QUOTE '"', ESCAPE '"', FORCE_QUOTE ("name"))

to-table-text.sql: COPY "app"."account" TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT text, NULL '', ENCODING 'LATIN1')
